project.location: Darwin and Litchfield National Park NT
project.title: Mountains to Mangroves: Wellbeing Walks
project.description: Mountains to Mangroves is a series of six monthly guided walks around Darwin and Litchfield National Park, combined with a two-hour Mental Health First Aid awareness session delivered by an accredited trainer. Many international students experience isolation and homesickness, particularly during their first semester. The program will provide regular, low-cost opportunities to exercise outdoors, build friendships across nationalities, and learn practical strategies for recognising and responding to stress.
project.who_can_attend: All international students studying in the Northern Territory are welcome, regardless of nationality or education provider. Participation is free and will be promoted through student associations and provider newsletters.
project.wellbeing_benefit: Participants will improve their physical health, reduce loneliness through new friendships, and gain practical skills to support their own mental health and that of their peers.
